# Vendored Dochia v0.1.1

`dochia.mjs` and [`dochia.txt`](../../public/licenses/dochia.txt) (the MIT license) are unmodified copies from
[danielpetrica/dochia-cycle-model@3e1ef364f218251ad6057e7d735b7006206ad210](https://github.com/danielpetrica/dochia-cycle-model/tree/3e1ef364f218251ad6057e7d735b7006206ad210).
The JavaScript reference embeds the published literature priors; this copy does
not include model weights fitted to restricted datasets or any participant data.
The app calls only the next-onset distribution functions. It does not
compute or expose ovulation/fertile-window outputs. Dottie’s forecast runs locally in the browser.
